SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(SYS160.SYS160_CMPS,' ') AS PLANT , PODT.PO_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM ICOYPOHD POHD, ICOYPODT PODT, ICOYCNDT CNDT, COM.SYS170TL SYS170, COM.SYS160TL SYS160 WHERE POHD.VENDOR_CODE = 'VC1290' AND POHD.IF_GR_FLAG = 'N' AND POHD.CHECK_REQ_NO IS NOT NULL AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.EXEC_NO = CNDT.EXEC_NO AND PODT.EXEC_SEQ= CNDT.EXEC_SEQ AND CNDT.ROOM_CD = SYS170.SYS170_ROOM_CD AND SYS170.SYS170_BLD_CD = SYS160.SYS160_BLD_CD GROUP BY SYS160.SYS160_CMPS, PODT.PO_NO ORDER BY SYS160.SYS160_CMPS, PODT.PO_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'DONGA' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , NVL(SYS160.SYS160_CMPS,' ') AS PLANT , PODT.PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , PODT.PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , 'C' AS STATUS , PODT.ITEM_CODE AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE , PODT.EST_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , PODT.REQ_QUTY AS GR_QTY , PODT.EST_AMT AS GR_AMT , POHD.CHECK_REQ_DATE AS GR_DATE , PODT.PO_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO , PODT.PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM ICOYPOHD POHD, ICOYPODT PODT, ICOYCNDT CNDT, COM.SYS170TL SYS170, COM.SYS160TL SYS160 WHERE POHD.VENDOR_CODE = 'VC1290' AND POHD.IF_GR_FLAG = 'N' AND POHD.PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.EXEC_NO = CNDT.EXEC_NO AND PODT.EXEC_SEQ= CNDT.EXEC_SEQ AND CNDT.ROOM_CD = SYS170.SYS170_ROOM_CD AND SYS170.SYS170_BLD_CD = SYS160.SYS160_BLD_CD ORDER BY PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ
UPDATE ICOYPOHD SET IF_GR_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$'
